# pve_mapping_dir (Resource)

Cluster resource mapping for directories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_mapping_dir" "example" {
  item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
  map     = ["CHANGE_ME"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The ID of the directory mapping
- `map` (List of String) A list of maps for the cluster nodes.

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `description` (String) Description of the directory mapping

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
